lines.zh: 每走一步，身后就多一道雪。
lines.en: Every step I take leaves a trail of snow.

lines.zh: 雪在我脚下响，咯吱咯吱。
lines.en: The snow crunches under me, over and over.
I do not tire; I only melt.
I walk on to see who hides in the dark.
My pumpkin head is heavy, but steady.
My arms are just two bare sticks.
The snowfield knows the sound of my steps.
Slow down; the snowball against me is cold.

lines.zh: 我留下的路，一会儿就没了。
lines.en: The path I leave vanishes before long.
With the sun this strong, I walk faster.
Bits of snow fall off me, as if leaking.
The wind strips a layer of white off me.
I tread on ice without slipping once.
Every blade of grass I pass turns a little white.
I stand still, and the snow keeps falling.
The flame in my pumpkin flickers softly.
No heartbeat, only the sound of wind.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不该出现的影子。
lines.en: I wait for a shadow that should not be here.

lines.zh: 雪球攒在手里，凉得刚好。
lines.en: The snowball in my hand is cold just right.
Anyone there? No, so I keep standing.
I never sleep; snowmen do not get sleepy.
Dripping from my rim? That means I am melting.
Somewhere far off, bones are rattling.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛转向声音那边。
lines.en: I turn my eyes toward that sound.
All this white is where I have been.

lines.zh: 谁把南瓜刻成这个笑脸？
lines.en: Who carved this smiling face into my pumpkin?
Cold is good; cold keeps me solid.

lines.zh: 我数雪花，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: I count snowflakes and forget halfway through.
You watch me, and I watch you back.

lines.zh: 你手里没有雪球，我放心。
lines.en: No snowball in your hands, so I relax.

lines.zh: 你的斗篷不错，能挡雨吗？
lines.en: Nice cloak; does it keep the rain out?
Do not come too close; I am cold.

lines.zh: 你哈出的气，跟我一样白。
lines.en: Your breath is white, just like mine.

lines.zh: 你要不要摸摸我的南瓜？
lines.en: Would you like to touch my pumpkin?

lines.zh: 你笑了，是因为我的脸吗？
lines.en: Are you smiling because of my face?

lines.zh: 你是来堆雪人的，还是来拆的？
lines.en: Did you come to build snowmen, or to break them?

lines.zh: 我记得你，上次你只带了两块雪。
lines.en: I remember you; last time you brought two snow blocks.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，一会儿会湿。
lines.en: The spot you stand on will soon be wet.

lines.zh: 你冷吗？我可以让你更冷。
lines.en: Are you cold? I could make you colder.
You nodded, so I take that as a yes.
A chunk of my snow just fell off.
Who hit me? My head has a dent.
It does not hurt; I just leak air now.
Not the pumpkin; that is my face.
That blow made me a whole head shorter.
Half of me scattered, but I still stand.
I can hear my own snow falling off.
Back off; I need to pack a new snowball.
It does not hurt, but I do melt.
That hit made the flame inside me flicker.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，你给我看这个？
lines.en: I do not eat; why show me food?

lines.zh: 南瓜后面是空的，装不下饭。
lines.en: My pumpkin is hollow; it cannot hold a meal.

lines.zh: 别拿面包引我，我没有嘴。
lines.en: Do not tempt me with bread; I have no mouth.

lines.zh: 我只会捡雪球，别的不会。
lines.en: I only pick up snowballs, nothing else.

lines.zh: 你的苹果很红，与我无关。
lines.en: Your apple is red, and it means nothing to me.
I have no belly, only packed snow.
Feed me? Give me a snowfall instead.

lines.zh: 你把食物收起来吧，浪费。
lines.en: Put the food away; it is wasted on me.

lines.zh: 我感兴趣的是你的手在动。
lines.en: What interests me is your moving hands.

lines.zh: 想让我跟着走，指个方向就行。
lines.en: To make me follow, just point a direction.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的雪蹭到你了。
lines.en: Sorry, my snow rubbed off on you.

lines.zh: 让一下，我要去那边站岗。
lines.en: Let me by; I need to stand guard over there.
Touch me and your hands will go cold.

lines.zh: 我挪不动太快，你等一等。
lines.en: I cannot move quickly, so please wait.
Snow knocked against snow and crumbled a little.
Do not push; this body collapses easily.
You stepped right into my snowy trail.
I will shift half a step; is that enough?
One bump and a handful of snow fell off.
Stand firm; let us not bump into each other.

lines.zh: 我和谁配？两个雪块加一个南瓜。
lines.en: Who would I pair with? Two snow blocks and a pumpkin.

lines.zh: 雪人没有家谱，只有刻痕。
lines.en: Snowmen have no family tree, only carved marks.
Build another one, and I will have company.

lines.zh: 我不生小崽子，我只掉雪。
lines.en: I bear no young; I only shed snow.

lines.zh: 找同伴？去雪原上多堆几个。
lines.en: Want me a companion? Stack a few more in the snowfield.
Pairing takes hands, not a heart.

lines.zh: 我的兄弟都化了，别提了。
lines.en: My brothers all melted; do not bring it up.

lines.zh: 再堆一个，记得用南瓜灯。
lines.en: Build one more, and use a jack o'lantern.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，也算一对。
lines.en: Standing side by side, we count as a pair.
Without snow, there is no next generation.
This snowball I will keep.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，放在胸口凉着。
lines.en: I pick it up and cool it against my chest.
Whose snowball was that? It is mine now.
I pinch it between my stick fingers.
Picking things up is hard; my hands are thin.
This handful of snow is one good shot.
I carry it against me; do not touch.
There is snow on the ground; I need not pick it up.
I tuck it into my chest and hide it.
Once I have this one, I am back on guard.
There is a shadow over there; I saw it.
Bones are moving, and I count three of them.
It has come far too close to the village.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，雪球已经攥好。
lines.en: I raise my arm, snowball already packed.

lines.zh: 目标确认：会走的，不是村民。
lines.en: Target confirmed: it walks, and it is no villager.

lines.zh: 我先喊一声，你不走我就打。
lines.en: I give one warning; leave or I throw.
That thing hates cold, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 它绕到树后了，我绕过去。
lines.en: It slipped behind a tree; I go around.
My eyes follow it as it moves.
It trampled the snow, and I remember that.
Halt; nothing passes this way.
The flame in my pumpkin burns a little brighter.
It is taller than me, but not as accurate.
I block the door; that is the rule.
Aim a little high; the wind blows left.
It moves, and I move with it.
Do not blink; the snowball travels fast.

lines.zh: 我算好了，它下一步往右。
lines.en: I have it figured; its next step goes right.
My arm aches, but I will not lower it.
It charges at me, which is just right.
I step back half a pace to aim better.
It is snarling; I pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 雪球在手里化了一点，快。
lines.en: The snowball is melting in my hand; hurry.

lines.zh: 它躲在暗处，我盯着暗处。
lines.en: It hides in the dark, so I watch the dark.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的胸口，那里最宽。
lines.en: I aim for its chest, the widest part.
I hear it breathing; it is close now.
This throw cannot go wide.
It hesitates; I do not hesitate at all.
Catch this snowball if you can!
One throw, right in its face.
The snowball burst, and it stepped back.
Another one, and my hands are quick.
It may not die, but it will feel that.

lines.zh: 雪灌进它领口，它跳起来了。
lines.en: Snow went down its collar, and it jumped.
My snowball is light, but very cold.
It took one hit and started backing off.
Do not run; I have plenty of snow left.

lines.zh: 这一发打偏了，下一发不会。
lines.en: That one went wide; the next will not.

lines.zh: 雪球从我手里飞出去，真快。
lines.en: The snowball leaves my hand so fast.
It tries to grab me and cannot reach.
I pack the snow tight and throw harder.

lines.zh: 打完这一发，我又攥了一团。
lines.en: After that throw, I pack another ball.

lines.zh: 两个雪块叠好，南瓜盖上。
lines.en: Two snow blocks stacked, a pumpkin on top.
My eyes light up, and I wake.
Whose hands stacked me into being?
The first thing I see is the snowfield.
There is fire in my pumpkin; I know the way.
I rise from the ground and stand straight.

lines.zh: 身上还带着堆雪人的手温。
lines.en: I still carry the warmth of the builder's hands.
My arms are sticks; let me move them.

lines.zh: 我叫不出声，只能看着你。
lines.en: I cannot call out, so I only look at you.
Barely awake, and I already want to stand guard.
The blocks are packed firm, so I stand steady.

lines.zh: 顶上的南瓜有点歪，扶一下。
lines.en: The pumpkin on top is crooked; let me fix it.
When I was born, everything around me was white.
Thank you for using a jack o'lantern.
Fire! My snow is turning into water.
I fell apart halfway; I am picking myself up.
Water is worse than fire; I am melting.
With a boom, half of me is gone.
An arrow sticks in my snow like a thorn.
The snow on me grows hot under that spell.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，可我会没力气。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I still run out of strength.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的南瓜裂了。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and my pumpkin cracked.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，雪都追不上。
lines.en: I am falling, and my snow cannot follow.
